conversation: A: Would you like me to help you move that desk?
B: No, that's ok. I can move it myself.
A: Oh, common. Let me give you a hand. There is no sense in moving it yourself if I am here to help.
B: Really, it's nice of you to offer.

B: ok, but I really don't want to trouble you, you know.
A: No trouble at all. Honestly, I am happy to give you a hand.
